# TOWARDS VICTORY — DIPLOMATIC ALLIANCE LAWS
# 5 law categories × 4 policy levels each
# Cohesion thresholds: L1=0, L2=25, L3=50, L4=75
# tv_alliance_tier is the sum of all current policy levels above 1
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# LAW 1: Court Protocol & Legitimacy (宫廷礼仪与法理认同)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tv_court_protocol = {
	type = international_organization
	law_category = diplomatic
	potential = {
		international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_diplomatic_alliance
	}
	allow = {
		always = yes
	}
	locked = {
	}
	has_levels = yes
	requires_vote = yes
	custom_tags = { forbids_no_policy }

	# Level 1 — Ad-hoc Envoys (initial, no effect)
	tv_adhoc_envoys_policy = {
		level = 1
		allow = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { international_organization_has_law = law:tv_court_protocol }
				international_organization_has_policy = policy:tv_resident_ambassadors_policy
			}
		}
		wants_propose_policy = {
			subtract = {
				desc = "TV_ALREADY_HAVE_BETTER"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_ALLIANCE_REFORM_BASE_BIAS"
				value = 0
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { international_organization_has_leader = yes } }
				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_IO_LEADER"
					value = {
						value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"
						multiply = 0
						min = 0
						max = 0
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "IO_LEADER_DIP_REP"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation
					multiply = 0
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Level 2 — Resident Ambassadors (cohesion ≥ 25)
	tv_resident_ambassadors_policy = {
		level = 2
		allow = {
			OR = {
				international_organization_has_policy = policy:tv_adhoc_envoys_policy
				international_organization_has_policy = policy:tv_refuse_pretenders_policy
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_ALLIANCE_COHESION_TT
				has_variable = tv_alliance_cohesion
			}
			var:tv_alliance_cohesion >= 25
		}
		on_activate = {
			change_variable = { name = tv_alliance_cohesion add = -25 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier add = 1 }
			leader_country = {
				change_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier add = 1 }
			}
			# Sync tier to leader country
		}
		on_deactivate = {
			change_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier add = -1 }
			leader_country = {
				change_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier add = -1 }
			}
		}
		country_modifier = {
			diplomatic_reputation = 1
		}
		wants_propose_policy = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_COHESION_REQUIREMENT"
				value = 20
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							custom_tooltip = {
								text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
								NOT = { has_variable = tv_alliance_cohesion }
							}
							var:tv_alliance_cohesion < 25
						}
					}
				}
				subtract = {
					desc = "TV_INSUFFICIENT_COHESION"
					value = 1000
				}
			}
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_ALLIANCE_REFORM_BASE_BIAS"
				value = -100
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { international_organization_has_leader = yes } }
				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_IO_LEADER"
					value = {
						value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"

		on_deactivate = {
			change_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier add = -2 }
			leader_country = {
				change_variable = { name = tv_alliance_tier add = -2 }
			}
		}
		country_modifier = {
			trade_land_efficiency = 0.05
			trade_sea_efficiency = 0.05
		}
		wants_propose_policy = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_COHESION_REQUIREMENT"
				value = 20
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							custom_tooltip = {
								text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
								NOT = { has_variable = tv_alliance_cohesion }
							}
							var:tv_alliance_cohesion < 50
						}
					}
				}
				subtract = {
					desc = "TV_INSUFFICIENT_COHESION"
					value = 1000
				}
			}
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_ALLIANCE_REFORM_BASE_BIAS"
				value = -200
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { international_organization_has_leader = yes } }
				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_IO_LEADER"
					value = {
						value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"
						multiply = 0.5
						min = -100
						max = 100
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "IO_LEADER_DIP_REP"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation
					multiply = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Level 4 — Syndicated Trade Monopolies (cohesion ≥ 75)
	tv_trade_monopoly_policy = {
		level = 4
		allow = {
			OR = {
				international_organization_has_policy = policy:tv_unified_measures_policy

		}
		on_deactivate = {

						}
					}
				}
				subtract = {
					desc = "TV_INSUFFICIENT_COHESION"
					value = 1000
				}
			}
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {

				value = -300
			}
			if = {

					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation

				}

		}
	}

# LAW 4: Faith & Ideological Harmony (信仰与意识形态调和)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tv_faith_harmony = {
	type = international_organization
	law_category = religious
	potential = {
		international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_diplomatic_alliance
	}
	allow = {
		always = yes
	}
	locked = {
	}
	has_levels = yes
	requires_vote = yes
	custom_tags = { forbids_no_policy }

	# Level 1 — Cuius Regio, Eius Religio (initial)
	tv_cuius_regio_policy = {
		level = 1
		allow = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { international_organization_has_law = law:tv_faith_harmony }
				international_organization_has_policy = policy:tv_pilgrim_protection_policy
			}
		}
		wants_propose_policy = {
			subtract = {
				desc = "TV_ALREADY_HAVE_BETTER"
				value = 100
			}
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_ALLIANCE_REFORM_BASE_BIAS"
				value = 0
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { international_organization_has_leader = yes } }
				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_IO_LEADER"
					value = {
						value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"
						multiply = 0
						min = 0
						max = 0
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "IO_LEADER_DIP_REP"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation
					multiply = 0
				}
			}
		}
	}

	tv_pilgrim_protection_policy = {
